result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback 90-day Deliverable/software conformance period and preserves repair, replacement, re-performance, and refund remedies, but it omits the required compliance-with-laws and no-malicious-code warranties. It also does not expressly establish the fallback 30-day Services warranty period. The change from delivery to acceptance is not required by the playbook and may materially defer the warranty start date, while “materially conform in all material respects” is redundant. Unrelated remedy carve-outs and the core commercial intent are otherwise preserved.
